data: Suite à une soirée trop arrosée et une nuit inoubliable avec une inconnue, Manu se réveille seul avec un message sur son bras lui donnant rendez-vous à Avignon. Persuadé qu’il s’agit de la femme de sa vie, il est prêt à tout pour la retrouver. Manu embarque, malgré lui, son pote Fred sur la route. Ce qui semblait être une simple virée entre amis va vite tourner à la catastrophe. (After a drunken evening and an unforgettable night with a total stranger, Manu wakes up alone to find a message on his arm giving him an appointment in Avignon. Convinced that the appointment is with the dreamy woman from the night before, he is ready to do anything to find her again. Despite his better judgement, Manu takes his pal Fred along for the ride. What seemed to be a simple trip between friends quickly turns into disaster.)

After a drunken evening and an unforgettable night with a total stranger, Manu wakes up alone to find a message on his arm giving him an appointment in Avignon. Convinced that the appointment is with the dreamy woman from the night before, he is ready to do anything to find her again. Despite his better judgement, Manu takes his pal Fred along for the ride.
